messages:
alex: Heads up — after rolling FP8 KV cache for mixtral@2.1 and mistral@1.5 in staging we're seeing p99 token latency up ~2.3x on long-prefix workloads. Reverting now but wanted to surface logs/profiles.

alex: repro curl (staging): `curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood.io/v1/generate -d '@payload.json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'` — use payload.json with prefix len ~1500 tokens.

alex: quick numbers from harness (mixed prefix ratio ~0.4): p50=18ms, p95=48ms (+25%), p99=210ms (+130%). CPU memcpy spikes around token emission.

maya: is this across batch sizes or just single-request tails?

jordan: saw same on perf harness. p50 ~ unchanged, p95 +25%, p99 +130% for seq_len 2048 with prefix cache hit rate ~40%. Batching helps avg but not p99.

li: profile snapshot: kernel selector chose `fp8-kv-write` for some heads but fell back to `fp16-gemm` for the big matmuls due to non-aligned head dims (heads * kv_dim % 8 != 0). That triggers extra convert kernels + memcpy.

pat: eviction logs look bad — after FP8 flip we set `kv_eviction_target_ratio: 0.7`. Mixed prefixes caused frequent LRU evictions and re-population, which amplifies memcpy + convert overheads.

maya: can you paste the kernel timeline? the extra convert ops are costly.

jordan: kernel timeline snippet from nvprof: ```kernel_timeline: [fp8_convert: 12ms, fp16_gemm: 45ms, fp8_write: 8ms, memcpy: 30ms]```. Also saw `convert_down` called repeatedly for the same prefix.

li: immediate mitigations we should consider: 1) force fp16 fallback if seq_len > 1024 OR head_dim%8 != 0, 2) add alignment padding to KV allocation for fp8 mode, 3) change `kv_eviction_policy` to be size-aware (pin hot prefixes).

alex: quick revert done (PR #2145) — flip back to fp16 kv cache on staging while we investigate.

ci-bot: deploy succeeded: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/2145 :white_check_mark:

pat: long-term: kernel selector needs to account for memcopy+convert cost and eviction churn, not just FLOPs. Also want microbench for Mixtral head_dim=64/kv_dim=128 combos and for odd-dimension models.

maya: plan of action: (1) add microbench harness that simulates mixed prefix hit ratios and different seq_lens, (2) add selector rule: require head_dim%8==0 for fp8 path, (3) bench fp8 vs fp16 with eviction simulation and measure p50/p95/p99 and memory traffic. I'll file tickets and owner.

maya: @alex @li can you attach kernel dumps / perf traces to the ticket? I'll assign the selector change to jordan.

alex: attaching perf traces + sample inputs in ticket. Also noticed small accuracy blips on a handful of prompts after fp8 truncation, not sure if related but worth tracking.

jordan: quick note — RoPE scaling interacts here: when we scale RoPE (long-prefix mode) attention matmul shapes change subtly and the selector mispredicts which kernel is best. That might explain model-specific behavior.

pat: I'll prototype a hybrid eviction policy: pin prefixes with >N hits for T minutes to reduce re-pop churn. If that lowers memcpy cycles we can retry fp8.

maya: awesome. Quick sync 2pm today to prioritize tickets and owners.

ci-bot: scheduled perf scrub job: perf/regression/1745032100
